action_items: (Info · from iter_38 still open) TournamentBasicsPanel meta state does not resync when parent tournament prop refreshes with a new setup_meta — currently OK because parent unmounts panel between saves, but note for future.

(Info) tournament_workspace.patch_setup_meta hard-$sets the whole setup_meta dict without a Pydantic model or size cap — malicious clients could write arbitrary keys. Consider constraining to whitelisted fields (category, age_group, teams, pools, division_pools, grounds, player_group, player_count).
critical_code_review_comments: TournamentBasicsPanel.jsx uses Math.random-based uid() for pool ids — OK for client-side keys but if a pool is saved and later renamed then more pools are added by another editor, ID collisions are theoretically possible. Consider crypto.randomUUID().

TournamentBasicsPanel.jsx toggleDivisionInPool auto-picks the first division as host when the current host is de-selected. That's convenient but silent; consider a toast so the user sees the host has changed.

TournamentDetail.jsx line 207 gates canEdit as `canEdit || persona?.body_type !== 'State'` — meaning ANY non-State persona (including District, Match Official) can edit the panel. Verify this matches RBAC intent; likely only Division Secretary should edit an inter-divisional tournament's pools.
